ruleDefinitions.name: Potentially Suspicious Windows App Activity
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potentially suspicious child process of applications launched from inside the WindowsApps directory. This could be a sign of a rogue ".appx" package installation/execution

sequences.query: parent_process_path = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\WindowsApps\\\\.*") AND ((process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\cscript\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\mshta\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\regsvr32\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\rundll32\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wscript\\\.exe$")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*cmd\\ \\/c.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Invoke\\-.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Base64.*"))) AND  NOT ((parent_process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\WindowsApps\\\\Microsoft\\\.WindowsTerminal.*") AND parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\WindowsTerminal\\\.exe$") AND (process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$"))))
